about: I build websites and web applications with PHP and Laravel, from backend features and APIs to responsive interfaces with Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap.
I also work with hosting and deployment, Figma-based UI design, and bots that help automate useful tasks. I graduated from SMKN 1 Karawang and continue to grow through hands-on development.
